set.body:
Outcome

Prove the repository after locus-data deletion and record exact evidence for the new ownership boundary.

Verification

- Run focused JVM and Scala.js suites for atlas, connectivity, dataset, image, latent, MVPA-spatial, spatial, surface, threshold, registry lifecycle, partition behavior, and neighborhoods.
- Run sbt compileAll and sbt testAll warning-clean.
- Run repository searches for scalafim.locus, locusData, MapEvidence, generic Parcellation/Searchlight storage, IndexedField compatibility use, and process-global DomainFactory.
- Verify parcel order/support, all-fiber planning, center order/membership, alignment errors, and explicit registry restoration.
- Inspect the resolved locus4s dependency revision and ensure no sibling-only or divergent API path is required.
- Record dirty-tree boundaries and preserve unrelated work.

Acceptance

- Every focused and aggregate JVM/Scala.js gate passes.
- Structural searches show the retired artifact and duplicate concepts are gone, apart from clearly historical documentation.
- The final evidence note records commands, counts, exact revisions, known unrelated failures if any, and the absence of a VolumeDomain ordinal conversion in this slice.
- The parent epic closes only after this court is complete.
set.title: Run the complete ScalaFIM locus-data removal migration court
